name: unavailable-state
title: Unavailable state
description: For a link that no longer works (expired, used, revoked or removed): the reason in words, the date it happened and the next step, with a resend cooldown.
docs: reason is 'expired', 'used', 'revoked' or 'removed': each has its own icon, title and explanation, and subject names what the link was ('invite', 'reset link'). occurredAt is written as a date in locale and timeZone (a date-only string as a day). The action fits the reason: expired offers onRequestNew, used offers signInHref first, revoked and removed offer homeHref. Asking for a new link shows a spinner while onRequestNew runs, then a cooldown (cooldownSeconds, default 30) with the seconds left, and says politely when the request went through, when it failed and when asking is possible again, on a line that has its room from the start so the card does not grow. It never shows a technical code. children add a line under the actions. The title is a heading at headingLevel (2 by default, 1 when the state is the whole page). labels carries every word.
